title: The Suit Still Stands
description: A suit of plate armor stands at the foot of the staircase, gauntleted hands resting on the pommel of a greatsword. It has stood there long enough that rust has bloomed across the pauldrons and crawled down into the joints. Then the visor turns toward you. There is nothing inside it - no eye, no light, no suggestion of a face - and yet the head has moved. The gauntlets tighten on the sword.

victory.narrative: The suit falls apart with a final, shuddering clang. The greatsword clatters to the floor, and the pieces of armor lie still.

standard_attack.telegraph: The greatsword rises in a long, deliberate arc, the rust-eaten edge now no more than a blunt blade.

special_attacks.telegraph: The hollow suit steps forward and thrusts at you, using the hilt of the sword as guard. Whoever this was, they carry the memories of a trained fighter.
The hollow suit raises the greatsword - It is trying to end the fight. The next blow is going to be tough, but you see plenty of openings.

pre_combat_narrative: It moves without sound. The armor does not creak. The joints do not grind. It simply moves.

visual.alt_text: A rusted suit of plate armor at the base of a stone staircase, greatsword raised, visor dark and empty.
